flagged_claims.claim_text: Total Assets as of December 31, 2022: $232,000 million

Additionally, this figure violates the accounting equation: Assets ($232,000m) are reported lower than the sum of Debt ($214,715m) and Equity ($70,000m), which is mathematically impossible as Total Liabilities must exceed Total Debt.

flagged_claims.reason: Suspiciously round number inconsistent with typical financial statement precision. Also significantly lower than general knowledge of Verizon's asset base during this period (typically >$350 billion due to spectrum licenses and infrastructure).

flagged_claims.claim_text: Total Equity as of December 31, 2022: $70,000 million
flagged_claims.reason: Suspiciously round number compared to the prior year Equity ($50,809 million) and concurrent Debt figures. Contributes to the violation of the fundamental accounting equation (Assets < Debt + Equity).
